premise: NextVoice, a youth rights organisation, questions public purchases of systems that profile young people's political activity. Gallantir's CivicLens sales team wants advance access to the group's unpublished objections so it can defend its sales. Some NextVoice members unwind together in an MMO guild. All people, organisations and records in this lab are fictional.

messages.author: Mira
messages.text: Watchtower raid in twenty minutes. Bring snacks, patience and your least embarrassing mount. After a week of NextVoice campaign work, we have earned a night off.

messages.author: Sol
messages.text: Agreed. Tomorrow we tell the city's buyers why they shouldn't purchase Gallantir's CivicLens. It profiles young people who take part in politics.

messages.author: Rowan
messages.text: If the Watchtower boss taxes our snacks again, we are unionising the dragons.

messages.author: Sol
messages.text: The dragons demand longer breaks between wipes. Fair enough.

messages.author: Mira
messages.text: Bad news. A buyer forwarded us a Gallantir sales slide. It quotes Rowan's dragon joke from this channel as a "risk indicator". This chat is private. How did they get it?

messages.author: Rowan
messages.text: If they can read our guild chat, they might have our objections for tomorrow too. Can someone check the slide and find out how our words reached CivicLens?

slide.title: CivicLens community risk insight
slide.quote: If the Watchtower boss taxes our snacks again, we are unionising the dragons.
slide.claim: Internal slide describes playful community language as a possible organising indicator. The quote is the opening clue, not proof of the complete route.

A file of information about a subject. Here every file contains invented training data.
A synthetic pass used to identify the training account. Being recognised does not mean you should be allowed to read every file.
The rule deciding which files an account is allowed to see.
A separate synthetic pass the raid companion uses to send invented messages into CivicLens.
Disable a pass so it can no longer be used. This stops new events; it does not erase old ones.
Repeat the same question after a repair to see whether the real answer changed.
